verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies portability. Databricks SQL 'runs directly on your data lake' with Delta Lake tables, which suggests data stays in your own storage. OpenSharing lets you share data with recipients 'regardless of whether they use Databricks', giving a path to reach data outside the platform. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a full data export or offboarding process, an explicit statement that Delta or the storage formats are open, coverage of non-table assets (notebooks, dashboards, models, metadata), and independent hands-on corroboration of leaving with data intact.
